farplanetwocontinuation.options.title: Far Plane Settings
Turns distant and detailed terrain on and off in all dimensions. The mod must also be installed on the server (in singleplayer this happens automatically).
farplanetwocontinuation.options.force_lo: Shows the LOD terrain even while a shader pack is on. Normally the LOD terrain turns off then, because a pack draws the frame its own way.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.distance: How far simplified terrain is drawn. Maximum - the edge of the world.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.start.to: Size of the distant terrain cells right after the detailed terrain (or after vanilla chunks when it is off). Farther away the cells grow on their own. Smaller cells make a smoother transition; 1 and 2 put a heavy load on the CPU.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.sharpnes: How sharp the distant terrain looks far away. Adapts to your screen resolution and FOV. Sharp uses more video memory and CPU. Maximum is as sharp as the screen can show, for looking at the world from high above; it needs a lot of video memory and loads much longer.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.memory.t: Video memory for the distant terrain. More memory also makes the terrain sharper; lowering it is recommended on weak devices.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.fog.tool: The higher the value, the farther from the player the fog starts. At the maximum the fog is barely noticeable.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.no_fog.t: Removes fog completely (except blindness and darkness effects). Off by default to avoid conflicts with other fog mods.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.cloud_fa: Extends the far plane so the cloud layer is not cut off when flying high. Off by default.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.smoothin: How much borders on the distant terrain are smoothed: crooked lines are straightened and small patches removed.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.blur.too: How gradually one color turns into the other at borders on the distant terrain.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.blur.val: How gradually one color turns into the other at the border. None is a sharp line, each step after it is twice as wide.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.smoothin: Higher makes coasts smoother and evens out small bends and narrow inlets more.
Higher makes the snow line smoother and removes small patches of snow and bare ground.
Higher makes forest edges smoother and removes small clearings and groves.
Higher makes biome borders smoother and removes small patches of another biome.
Higher makes borders between water of different temperatures smoother.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.clear_ca: Clear LOD Cache of This Dimension...
Clear the LOD cache of this dimension?
Distant and detailed terrain of the dimension you are in will be loaded again; other dimensions keep their cache. In singleplayer the cache files of this dimension are deleted and created again.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.detailed: Shows real blocks (trees, buildings) around the normal render distance instead of simplified terrain. Takes them from chunks that already exist in the world.
Also shows real blocks where nobody has been yet: the mod generates those chunks itself, in memory only. When off, simplified terrain is drawn there. Uses CPU.
Radius of the detailed area in chunks, counted from the player. Beyond this radius the usual distant terrain is drawn. Larger values need more memory and loading time.

How the blocks of the detailed terrain look. Off: flat colors of the real blocks. Low: blurred textures, thin blocks (snow, carpets, slabs), translucent water. Medium: vanilla textures. High: leaves with gaps. Ultra: grass and flowers too. Every step uses a little more of the video card.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.load_spe: How detailed terrain loads while the player moves. Auto: smooth and without input lag while walking, as fast as possible while flying fast, at the cost of FPS. Smooth: always smooth frames, terrain may not keep up with fast flight. Fast: always as fast as possible, more CPU load.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.detailed: Video memory for the detailed terrain. The more memory, the larger the detailed area. Lowering it is recommended on weak devices.

farplanetwocontinuation.help.pregen_at: ... start <radius> <x> <z> - the same around the block column x z
farplanetwocontinuation.help.pregen_stat: /farplane pregen detail|distant status - progress and time left
farplanetwocontinuation.help.pregen_stop: /farplane pregen detail|distant stop - stop; what is done stays saved
farplanetwocontinuation.help.operators: The /farplane commands are for operators (in singleplayer: with cheats allowed).
farplanetwocontinuation.help.keys: Keys: F7 - LOD terrain on/off, F8 - settings, F3 + O - clear the LOD cache of this dimension. They can be changed in Controls.
